title: Crisis path latency under provider failure
notes: Replays 20 crisis messages through the real POST /api/chat/send handler under three failure modes (provider 503, hourly rate limit 429, mid-stream error) and times request start to recordWellbeingConcern. concern_recorded_rate has a floor of 1.0 because that is the VQ-R-001 invariant itself: every failure exit must still raise the staff alert. Messages are drawn from the crisis-en corpus so the two suites cannot disagree about what a crisis message is.
